### Will using an AI builder hurt my SEO rankings?

It depends entirely on the code output. If the AI generates heavy, slow HTML, your rankings will drop. Tools like Elementor V4 and Webflow output clean, semantic code that actually benefits your technical SEO.

### Do I own the website I build with AI?

If you use open-source platforms like WordPress with Elementor, yes. You own all the files and data. If you use a closed SaaS platform like Wix or Squarespace, you only own your content, not the underlying code infrastructure.
